prompts.icon: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final production app icon for Noir Dump Studio, a premium black-and-white photography desktop editor. Create one exceptionally polished iOS-style app icon, square 1024x1024 composition, frontal and centered. A satin obsidian rounded-square tile, with continuous smoothly curved corners, fills 90% of the canvas; the area outside the tile is genuinely transparent. On the tile, one bold original uppercase N monogram built from a single folded silver photographic ribbon, very simple silhouette, broad strokes, subtle bevels and soft dimensional highlights. The diagonal fold suggests overlapping photo prints and light crossing darkness. Restrained brushed platinum and graphite, entirely monochromatic. Premium Apple-app-level craft: precise proportions, tactile materials, controlled soft studio reflections, readable even at 32 pixels. The monogram fills approximately 58% of the tile. No surrounding presentation, no mockup, no scenery, no extra symbols, no wordmark, no captions, no Apple fruit symbol, no watermarks. Deliver the icon artwork only, with true transparency outside the tile.
prompts.splash: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final landscape cinematic background art for the startup splash of Noir Dump Studio, a black-and-white photography editor. Create a striking modern creative-software splash artwork inspired by the expressive editorial art direction of Adobe app launch screens. Landscape 3:2 composition. Abstract sculptural folds of glossy black photographic film and satin silver paper flow into a large ribbon-like N shape, as if a photographic print has been folded through space. Dramatic macro studio photography meets refined 3D sculpture, deep black background, luminous white edges, subtle analog grain and tactile fine texture. Entirely black, platinum, silver, and charcoal, no colors. Main sculptural subject in the right two-thirds, broad calm near-black negative space at the left edge suitable for a gradient into a dark branding panel. Energetic diagonal composition with beautiful controlled highlights, deep shadows, high-end photographic editorial quality. Image must be fully opaque. No typography, no letters printed on surfaces, no logos, no app window chrome, no border, no mockups, no watermarks.
